headline: Ticking the right boxes

highlights: Results reflected continued ordering improvement and recovery in margin performance, thereby increasing our confidence in revenue growth and margin improvement going forward.
Order inflows stood at INR47.3b (up 56% YoY), taking the order book to INR129b (up 36% YoY).
This was driven by a sharp growth in orders from data centers, utilities, metals and mining, F&B, cement, and building and infrastructure.
We believe that the impact of price hikes taken in the past few quarters will support healthy revenue growth and has already started boosting margins across segments.
valuation: We arrive at our revised TP of INR8,200, implying 60x Dec’28E P/E.
Valuation and recommendation At CMP of INR7,045, the stock is trading at 63.0x/51.7x P/E on CY27/28 estimates.
Key risks and concerns Slowdown in order inflows, pricing pressure across segments, increased competition, supply chain issues, and geopolitical risks could affect our estimates and valuations.
watch: Segmental outlook improving across electrification and motion Order inflows during the quarter rose 56% YoY to INR47.3b.
With improving traction across key growth areas and price hikes, we expect the strong execution momentum to continue for the electrification segment.
